lines.text: Panel one. Our hero leaves the barber shop looking sharp... and forgets to rebook.
Heh heh heh. No reminder? He'll wait two months, look like a mop, and walk into the shop down the street!
Panel three. The barber unleashes... the rebooking bot!
Beep. It has been three weeks. Want your usual, Saturday at ten? Reply YES.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Rebooking reminders that keep your chair full. Comment CUT and we'll show you how. You're still the captain.
